reason: EXP-LOCAL-001 terminated without a formal outcome or a product policy selection, so the original EXP-DISC-001 instruction to freeze its champion is impossible to satisfy. This prospective, outcome-unobserved amendment replaces only that dependency with a current-core local-champion chain while preserving every discovery candidate, threshold, budget, control, safety gate and tuning limit fixed by the original card, A1 and A2.

reviewed: The committed EXP-DISC-001 original card, A1 and A2
The terminal EXP-LOCAL-001 governance closure and termination
evidence_boundary.restriction: This amendment changes only the upstream local-champion dependency. It cannot select a local or discovery algorithm, tune any threshold, authorize product connection, or support a discovery promotion or rejection.

superseded_phrases.replacement: Complete or terminally close EXP-LOCAL-003, freeze its protocol-valid locked-passing scaling candidate or explicitly freeze L0-SEMANTIC, then preregister and execute EXP-LOCAL-004 against that frozen scaling policy and create the outcome-bound local-champion freeze record required below.

relation_to_prior_preregistration.unchanged: Every other original-card provision and every A1/A2 correction remains binding. In particular, discovery variants, controls, input-family separation, proposal-prefix construction, budgets, metrics, promotion and kill gates, liveness audits, safety requirements and the original two-round tuning limit are unchanged.

ordered_steps.requirement: Execute the preregistered semantic-preserving scaling protocol through a valid decision or record its terminal protocol/infrastructure state without retry outside that protocol.
ordered_steps.freeze: If and only if a candidate passes the preregistered development and locked gates, freeze that locked-passing scaling candidate. Otherwise explicitly freeze L0-SEMANTIC; a development-only result is never sufficient.

ordered_steps.requirement: After the EXP-LOCAL-003 scaling-policy freeze, create a separate outcome-unobserved preregistration for a current-core native-globalization study and execute it with that exact frozen scaling policy. EXP-LOCAL-004 must preserve the open C0 black-box DSL/plugin path, semantic/canonical answer predicates and charged fixed-budget comparison.
ordered_steps.freeze: A globalization candidate is eligible only after its own protocol-valid locked pass. Otherwise freeze the current LM-QR globalization control while retaining the already frozen EXP-LOCAL-003 scaling policy. The study cannot infer globalization efficacy from EXP-LOCAL-003 or from any non-gating pilot.

ordered_steps.requirement: Create this record only after EXP-LOCAL-004 has a valid decision or terminal closure. It selects exactly one complete local pipeline and binds the outcome artifacts, exact source and exact options described below.

local_champion_dependency_chain.failure_fallback: Fallback is stage-local. If EXP-LOCAL-003 has no protocol-valid locked-passing candidate, freeze L0-SEMANTIC. If EXP-LOCAL-004 has no protocol-valid locked-passing candidate, freeze the current LM-QR globalization control with the scaling policy already frozen by step 1. Thus a locked-passing EXP-LOCAL-003 scaling policy is not discarded merely because a later globalization candidate fails, while an unvalidated intermediate candidate is never selected. EXP-LOCAL-001/002 and every other non-gating pilot remain ineligible.
local_champion_dependency_chain.no_implicit_champion: A terminal experiment without a passing locked candidate never silently promotes its best development row. A named control selection and its hashes are mandatory.

local_champion_freeze_record.timing: Created after EXP-LOCAL-004 terminates and before any EXP-DISC-001 candidate input, assessor input, proposal matrix or outcome is materialized.
required_bindings: EXP-LOCAL-001 closure and termination commits plus closure SHA-256 from this amendment
EXP-LOCAL-003 card hash, card-chain tip, merge commit, terminal decision/closure commits and every decision-authority input/result hash
EXP-LOCAL-004 card hash, terminal decision/closure commits and every decision-authority input/result hash
the selected scaling-policy ID or explicit L0-SEMANTIC fallback, and independently the selected globalization-policy ID or explicit current LM-QR globalization control
the exact Julia local-solver source tree or enumerated source-file SHA-256 values
the exact canonical LocalSolveOptions bytes and SHA-256, including every integer, boolean, enum and binary64 hexadecimal value
the compiler, plugin ABI, problem-wire, solve-API and environment/Manifest versions and hashes needed to replay that local pipeline
local_champion_freeze_record.selection_rule: Each experimental component requires its own locked-passing authority. A missing scaling authority falls back to L0-SEMANTIC; a missing globalization authority falls back to current LM-QR without undoing an independently locked-passing scaling policy. The record names the resulting complete pipeline explicitly, never a development-only winner.
local_champion_freeze_record.immutability: After the record is bound into EXP-DISC-001 input manifests, any local source, option, ABI, compiler or environment change invalidates materialization and requires a new prospective discovery experiment; it cannot be repaired by amending or regenerating EXP-DISC-001 outcomes.

allowed_only_after: The outcome-bound local-champion freeze record exists and validates all required bindings.
The EXP-DISC-001 original card, A1, A2 and A3 bytes and SHA-256 values are frozen together.
The exact selected local source and canonical options hashes in every candidate and assessor manifest match the freeze record.
forbidden_before_gate: IID, Halton, Sobol or randomized-QMC proposal-matrix materialization
disc_materialization_gate.downstream_manifest_rule: Every EXP-DISC-001 development and locked manifest, proposal artifact, raw result and summary must bind the original card, A1, A2, A3 and local-champion freeze-record SHA-256 values plus the exact champion source/options hashes.

freeze_rule: Commit A3 with the original card, A1 and A2 unchanged before creating any formal EXP-DISC-001 input or proposal matrix. A3 itself is not the champion record and authorizes no materialization until the complete dependency chain and outcome-bound freeze record exist.
